name: Embers, Mass Lesser
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5

EFFECT

Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 15)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as lesser embers except it affects multiple targets.
